findings.claim: Original readonly management launcher adds an explicit canonical installation UUID option restricted to management readonly mode, requiring existing local OIDC config, and reuses select_current_installation before startup. Environment is scrubbed and only bounded server-selected org-org/dev-project installed readonly configuration is injected; readonly DB, original mutation and websocket fences, Host/worker/Provider OFF remain unchanged. This grants installed asset viewing only, not business/runtime or approval authority.
findings.evidence: Material r2-material-0.txt (diff for scripts/a0v_qyh_restored_http.py): (1) New function installed_readonly_environment accepts installation_id with canonical UUID validation (str(UUID(installation_id)) != installation_id raises RestorationBlocked('INSTALLED_READONLY_SELECTION_INVALID')) and requires non-None management_oidc_config (raises RestorationBlocked('INSTALLED_READONLY_REAL_LOGIN_REQUIRED')), injecting only {'installationId':..., 'orgId':'org-org', 'projectId':'dev-project'} into AOS_INSTALLED_READONLY_CATALOG. (2) serve_management_readonly gains installed_readonly_installation parameter; if provided, calls select_current_installation(...) and merges readonly_catalog_environment into environment. (3) main() CLI validates '--installed-readonly-installation' requires '--serve-management-readonly' (parser.error). Material r2-material-3.txt (build_installed_readonly_catalog): enforces bounded set(config) == {'installationId','orgId','projectId'}, canonical string checks, and requires AOS_LOCAL_MANAGEMENT_OIDC_CONFIG + AOS_BUNDLE_ROOT + trust roots. Material r4-extra-1.txt: ReadOnlyManagementApp still rejects websocket (code 1008) and non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/POST-token with 405 RESTORED_MANAGEMENT_READ_ONLY; FLAGS remain byte-identical to HEAD with Host/worker/Provider disabled.
